## Small Blood Elemental (CR 1)

**XP** 400  
N Small outsider (elemental, extraplanar, sanguine)  
**Init** +4; **Senses** bloodsense, darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4  


**Defense**


**AC** 17, touch 11, flat-footed 17 (+6 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 22 (2d10+2)  
**Fort** +4; **Ref** +3; **Will** +0  
**Immune** elemental traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft., swim 60 ft (only in bodies of blood such as rivers of blood, lakes of blood, etc.)  
**Melee** slam +5 (1d6+3 plus bleed)  
**Ranged** blood missile +3 (1d4+2/x3, 70 feet, drains the blood elemental of 1 HP per attack)  
**Special Attacks** bleed (1), blood drain (1 Con), drench, engulf (Ref DC 13, blood drain)  


**Statistics**


**STR** 14, **Dex** 10, **Con** 13, **Int** 5, **Wis** 11, Cha 11  
**BAB** +2; **CMB** +3 ; **CMD** 13  
**Feats** [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +4 (+0 if jumping), Escape Artist +4, Knowledge (planes) +1, Perception +4, Stealth +8 (+16 in bodies of blood), Swim +11 (in blood only); Racial Modifiers +8 on Stealth in bodies of blood  
**SQ** blood gourmand, bloody arsenalist  


**Special Abilities**


**Blood Gourmand (Ex)** Upon successfully incurring Constitution damage via their blood drain ability, a blood elemental experiences a temporary empowerment in their physical capabilities. This provides the blood elemental with a +1 bonus on attack rolls and Reflex saves, +1 dodge bonus to AC, and fast healing 1. In addition, their movement speeds increase by 5 feet.
